_doc: The series' sound design for pipeline/sound.py. kinds: the cue kind the picture records (reel/lib/kit.js R.cue) -> [real-sfx event kind, base gain g (1.0 = the role's nominal level)]; null = no sound (hard cuts are carried by the music). A cue's weight scales g by its square root. real_sfx_kinds: our own kinds told to real-sfx's from_cues.py (--kind NAME=TARGET). real_sfx_map: per real-sfx kind, its pick and keys copied onto every cue of that kind (gain_db added to its level, highpass in Hz: hits keep out of the song's 808). density: at most this many sounds in any 10 s, heaviest cues first (real-sfx: 3-9 weighted events per 10 s for a film with its own music; earshot's music-led launch films: 3-13). mix_flags: real-sfx mix.py flags; the song is never ducked and the mix never loudness-normalised (pipeline/sound.py adds --no-loudnorm). quiet: [start, end] stretches in seconds that get no effects (a whispered line); usually set per week. A week overrides any key in reel/weeks/WEEK/sound.json.
